branded.why: So much the Dutch chocolate milk that its name stands for chocolate milk itself.

about.text: Chocomel is a trademarked chocolate milk, sold mainly in the Netherlands, where its name is often used for chocolate milk in general. It is made from partly skimmed milk with sugar, about 1.7% cocoa, a stabiliser and a thickener, by FrieslandCampina.
